name: live-qa

scripts.deploy: scripts/require-env.sh CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID && vite build && wrangler deploy ${DOMAIN:+--domains $DOMAIN} ${PRIVACY_OPERATOR:+--var "PRIVACY_OPERATOR:$PRIVACY_OPERATOR"} ${PRIVACY_CONTACT:+--var "PRIVACY_CONTACT:$PRIVACY_CONTACT"} && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.load: scripts/require-env.sh BASE_URL && load/cleanup.sh scratch-read-write && ROOM=scratch-read-write k6 run --quiet load/audience.js
scripts.load:read: scripts/require-env.sh BASE_URL && load/cleanup.sh scratch-read && ROOM=scratch-read VOTES_PER_SECOND=0 QUESTIONS_PER_SECOND=0 RAMP=15s k6 run --quiet load/audience.js
scripts.load:write: scripts/require-env.sh BASE_URL && load/cleanup.sh scratch-write && ROOM=scratch-write READERS=0 k6 run --quiet load/audience.js
scripts.load:report: K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_EXPORT=load/report.html K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_PERIOD=1s K6_WEB_DASHBOARD_OPEN=false K6_SUMMARY_EXPORT=load/summary.json pnpm run load
scripts.load:switch: scripts/require-env.sh BASE_URL SESSION_SECRET USER_ID && node load/switch.mjs
scripts.load:clean: scripts/require-env.sh BASE_URL && load/cleanup.sh scratch-read-write scratch-read scratch-write scratch-switch

description: Self-hosted live Q&A for conferences, with built-in translation
